props.title: In This Land Lay Graves of Mine
props.initialSlug: Where the dead walk the land.

sections.content: **Pet Sematary** (1989) and its 2019 remake explore sacred burial grounds and their dark powers. **Poltergeist** (1982) famously deals with homes built on burial sites, while **The Ritual** (2017) dives into ancient grounds and folklore. These films connect deeply to themes of sacred land and ancestral territory.
